name: framework
description: Owns the installation record and everything done to a project, under src/contexts/framework/ — the manifest aggregate, and the setup/install/restore/uninstall/doctor orchestration built on top of it. This is the only context allowed to reach `translate` and `distribution`. Use when adding a use-case that touches the manifest, a setup/doctor/sync/uninstall flow, a new top-level CLI orchestration, or a launcher that runs an external binary (kanban-shaped). Do NOT use for a tool's own profile or capability classes — use `tools`. Do NOT use for the translation pipeline — use `translate`. Do NOT use for where content is fetched from — use `distribution`.
